name: Fever spiders

variantInfo.name: Fever spider
notes: Found only in the Braindeath Island brewery basement (Rum Deal).
Attacking without Slayer gloves deals 12.5% max-HP damage and inflicts disease.

locationComparison.name: Braindeath Island
notes: 11 spawns in the brewery basement; the sole Fever spider location.
Many crate safespots; the south-west corner is noted.
Cannon placement is not wiki-stated; the conservative default is used.

taskNotes: Fever spiders require 42 Slayer, 40 combat, and partial Rum Deal to be assigned; Rum Deal must be started to access Braindeath Island.
slayerTargetId 251 is SYNTHETIC (WC-1..11 allocation contract: 240 + WC index); the real SLAYER_TARGET varp value is a QA live-verify item.
Slayer gloves must be worn when attacking, or the player takes 12.5% max-HP damage and becomes diseased.
Disease drains stats; bring a Relicym's balm when safespotting without Slayer gloves.
Fever spiders have a 25% elemental weakness to fire spells.
They attack with stab melee, max hit 4 (1-12 without slayer gloves), and are not aggressive.
The brewery basement has many crate safespots for ranged and magic users.
No task extension unlock exists for Fever spiders.
recommendedMethod: Wear Slayer gloves and kill the 11 brewery-basement spiders with melee; their low defences and max hit of 4 make the task trivial. Ranged or magic users can crate-safespot with better offensive gloves (bring Relicym's balm), and fire spells exploit the 25% elemental weakness.
